title: Arcanadea TV Anime Casts M.A.O, Ai Kakuma
content:
The staff for the television anime of Kotobukiya 's Arcanadea bishōjo plastic model series revealed two more cast members on Thursday. Both cast members (character name romanizations below are not confirmed) are reprising their roles from previous works in the franchise.

M.A.O as Elmeda

Ai Kakuma as Sofiella

The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on TV Asahi and 24 total stations across Japan in the NUMAnimation programming block. The anime will also air on BS Asahi .

Kaede Hondo will continue to voice the character Lumitea in the anime. Hondo already voices the character in the short video version of the franchise's four-panel manga titled YuruCanadea ( YuruCana in short).

The anime will also star:

• Miho Okasaki as Velretta

• Rina Hidaka as Yukumo

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Shōgo Kuga

• Konomi Inagaki as Kaho Asagi

• Mai Kanno as Rin Kirinoue

• Moka Kanzaki as Ghi

Kotobukiya is credited with the original work. Keiichirō Kawaguchi ( Sket Dance , Spy Classroom , Psychic Squad ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab . Atsuhiro Tomioka ( Pokémon XY , Trinity Blood , Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest ) is overseeing the series scripts. Kumoha Arakawa (name romanization not confirmed) is adapting necömi 's original character designs for animation. Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ) and Yūki Furuhashi ( My Hero Academia: Vigilantes ) are composing the music.

The "sci-fi x fantasy" franchise takes place in the near future, where the world experienced rapid technological development thanks to a new energy called "Arcana Particles" that was discovered by Eden Industries. The new technology includes the largest virtual space server called Eden. The VRMMO " ARCANADEA " is a game people can play within the Eden server, and features a fantasy world. After an explosion occurred at Eden Industries one night during the maintenance of Eden, the world changed, including abnormal weather, communication issues, strange disappearances, and people gaining increased physical abilities.

The franchise has inspired not just plastic models but also various other merchandise and a series of ASMR CDs. The franchise's official website also publishes a four-panel manga .

The franchise launched in December 2021 and has shipped over 500,000 figures as of June 2025.
author: ANN

title: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess TV Anime Reveals January 1 Debut in Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Kotoko and artist Kaname Hanamiya 's The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me ( Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Nazeka Last Boss О̄jisama ni Shūchaku Sareteimasu ) manga revealed the show's main promotional video on Thursday, alongside the announcement of the show's debut on January 1.

The anime will debut on January 1 at 10:30 p.m. on AT-X . The series will then air on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , and CBC TV on January 8. The series will stream on services such as d Anime Store , ABEMA , and more in Japan starting on January 1 at 25:00 (effectively January 2 at 1:00 a.m.).

Additionally, the website revealed one more cast member, the theme song artists, and the main visual on Thursday.

Yoshitsugu Matsuoka will voice Richard (pictured above with white hair) in the series.

REIRIE performs the opening theme song "Yorore Yoen," and SERRA performs the ending theme song "Silhouette Letter."

The anime stars:

• Haruka Shiraishi as Celine

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Wilfred

• Shunichi Toki as Lewis

• Fūka Izumi as Adele

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings with Shūsaku Katо̄ as the assistant director. Mitsutaka Hirota ( Edens Zero ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Infinite is producing.

Additional staff members include:

• Character Designer: Nozomi Ikuyama, Fumino Kakihata, Yukiko Sekita

• Art Directors: Yuri Takagi, Keito Watanabe

• 3D Art Setting/3D Layout: Jishiro Shida

• Color Key Artist: Taeko Mizuno

• 2D Design: Suguru Shiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kenji Takehara

• Editing: Hitomi Sudō

• Sound Director: Ryōsuke Naya

• Sound Effects: Yuka Kazama

• Music: Tsubasa Itō

Media Do , NTT Docomo , Akatsuki Group, and MyAnimeList 's joint digital manga distribution service Manga Mirai is publishing the series in English ( until December), and it describes the story:

After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession..! Will Celine be able to find “peaceful happiness”? A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a Yandere.

Kotoko and Hanamiya launch the manga in April 2023. The sixth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on October 1. The series has over 70 million downloads.
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Releases Creditless Opening Featuring Tempalay Ahead of Today's Netflix Premiere
content:
FOOL NIGHT anime has released its creditless opening sequence ahead of the series’ worldwide Netflix premiere today (November 26, 2026). This is the first-ever joint project between studios SHAFT and SUNRISE, set to have a total of 12 episodes. Atsuyuki Yukawa directed the anime, which is his directorial debut. The anime features character designs by Robert Sato, with Jin Tanaka in charge of the series composition. The full staff includes:

• Director: Atsushi Yukawa

• Series Composition: Jin Tanaka

• Character Design: Robert Sato

• Assistant Director: Ryo Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryo Kikuchi

• Background Director: Maki Takano (J.C.STAFF)

• Color Design: Hitoshi Hibino

• Compositing Director: Mana Ishikawa (Animocaramel),Chiaki Tokuda (TERAEFFECT),Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Director: Naoki Yamamoto,Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editorial Office)

• Sound Director: Yota Tsuruoka

• Music: Tatsuya Kato

• Animation Production: SUNRISE×SHAFT

The main English dub cast was announced with the previous trailer, while the Japanese voice cast includes:

• Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

• Kiyomitsu Mizuchi as Jin Hiragishi

The opening song is “Shake! spit out” by Tempalay, and you can watch the video below.

Also check out the new key visual:

Fool Night is a Japanese seinen manga written and illustrated by Kasumi Yasuda. The series began serialization in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020 and has released 13 volumes so far. It is also available in English through VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan Asia in Southeast Asia.

Set in a future where sunlight no longer reaches Earth and oxygen is running out, Fool Night follows a society that survives through “transfloration,” a process that turns humans into plants. The story centers on Toshiro Kamiya, a struggling young man who chooses this transformation but unexpectedly gains the ability to hear plants, leading him into work that connects humans with their transformed loved ones. The official introduction:

Official introduction:

Hurry up and turn me into a beautiful flower. Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival. In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration. A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope. Living… there isn’t a single thing fun about it. In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the “Spiriflor” — the plants that humans transform into. Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Fool Night' Announced
content:
The official website of the Fool Night original net anime announced a supporting cast pair on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga is streaming worldwide exclusively on Netflix, with all 12 episodes released simultaneously on November 26.

Voice actors Nobuo Tobita ( Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ) and Akiko Yajima ( Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi ) are joining in the anime as Ootaro Kyudai and Shiika Izumi, respectively.

Atsushi Yukawa ( Suzume no Tojimari episode director) helms the anime at Sunrise and Shaft . Jin Tanaka ( [Oshi no Ko] ) is handling the series composition, and Robert Satou is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katou ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Yasuda began serializing the sci-fi drama in Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan published the 13th volume on June 30.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023 and released the tenth volume on September 15. The 11th volume is planned to go on sale on December 15.

title: Main Cast for 'Monster Strike: Mera×Death - Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi' Announced
content:
The official website of the Monster Strike: Mera×Death - Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi ( Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper ) television anime announced the main cast on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX and other stations on January 5.

Cast Mera Kagari: Kaito Ishikawa ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai ) Thirteen: Shion Wakayama ( Dandadan ) Mizuki Kagari: Hana Hishikawa ( Sayonara Lara ) Renge: Misaki Kuno ( 3-gatsu no Lion )

Kenta Kushiya ( Kaijuu 8-gou episode director) is helming the anime at Qzil.la ( Champignon no Majo ) and Studio Keel . Daisuke Oohigashi ( Fate/strange Fake ) is handling the series composition and screenplay. Tadashi Sakazaki ( Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru ) is designing the characters. Masaru Yokoyama ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. ), Kana Hashiguchi ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ), and Natsuki Hamada ( Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken ) are composing the music.

Mixi developed Monster Strike , which first launched in Japan for iOS in September 2013 under the XFLAG brand, followed by an Android release in December of the same year. A North American version was released in October 2014, but its service ended in August 2017.

The franchise's anime adaptation started with the first series , which aired for 51 episodes from October 2015 to December 2016. The second season was streamed from April to September 2017, with a total of 23 episodes. It was followed by the 13-episode third season, Kieyuku Uchuu-hen ( The Fading Cosmos ), which ran from October 2017 to January 2018. The fourth series later streamed for 63 episodes from July 2018 to December 2019.

The franchise's theatrical film series began with Hajimari no Basho e ( To The Place of Beginnings ), which premiered in Japanese theaters in December 2016 as a prequel to the first net anime series. The third and latest film, Lucifer - Zetsubou no Yoake , opened in Japanese theaters in November 2020.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 Preview Images Show Yuno vs Zenon
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 9 (Episode 179 overall) ahead of its November 30 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Valkyrie Dress Noelle after Episode 6. The official Episode 9 “Yuno Grinberryall” synopsis:

Yuno, Langris and Finral find themelves in a life-or-death situation as they come under attack from Zenon, who has obtained the Devil’s Heart. Despite having been chosen as the vice-commander of the “Golden Dawn”—the Kingdom of Clover’s strongest order of magic knights—Yuno grits his teeth in frustration at his inability to protect his comrades. Just then, a grimoire flutters down to him—. Meanwhile, at the site of the Chliphoth’s descent, Dorothy’s dream magic had been shattered by Morris, who had obtained the power of a demon. Just as the gate to the Second Layer of the Underworld was about to open, members of the Black Bulls, riding the Black Rampaging Bull, arrive to rescue Yami‼

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!
author: Anime Corner

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: 1st Witch on the Holy Night Film Opens at #2
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , stayed at #1 in its third weekend in Japan, and sold 352,000 tickets to earn 589,950,800 yen (about US$3.70 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 3.32 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 5.3 billion yen (about US$33.3 million) as of Monday, taking the Labor Thanksgiving Day holiday in Japan into account.

The film has also become the highest-earning live-action IMAX film in Japan (counting earnings from IMAX screenings exclusively).

The film ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 699,000 tickets and earned 1,130,171,300 yen (about US$7.11 million) over the November 6-8 weekend.

The film had an irregular opening day in Japan, opening on Tuesday, November 3 (films in Japan usually open on Fridays), which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. The film sold 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan on its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan. The film sold 1.61 million tickets and earned 2,539,531,100 yen (about US$15.98 million) in its first six days.

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō also returned to compose the music. Shirogumi Inc. handled the film's visual effects.

The Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 256,000 tickets and earned 107,603,830 yen (about US$676,000) in its first three days, but sold 301,630 tickets for 516,132,800 yen (about US$3.24 million) over its first four days, taking the Labor Thanksgiving Day holiday in Japan into account.

The film opened on regular and IMAX screens in Japan on November 20. The original visual novel game's smartphone version launched on the same day as the film's opening in Japan. The film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27. In particular, the anime studio ufotable produced about 981 updated shots, or 67 minutes and six seconds of the film's 129-minute runtime, for the footage projected onto the two side screens for the Screen X release.

The film will have a sequel .

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern ma ges. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

The first of two films in Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch) anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 96,000 tickets and earned 165 million yen (about US$1.03 million) in its first three days, and sold 120,000 tickets and earned approximately 200 million yen (about US$1.26 million) in its first four days.

The first film opened in Japan on November 20. The second film will open in 2027.

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (featured in visual right), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg, an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the films. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music. Mika Nakashima performs the first film's theme song "Na mo Naki Shijin no Yō ni" (Like Some Nameless Poet). Toshihiko Takamizawa , the vocalist and guitarist for the band THE ALFEE , wrote, composed, and arranged the song.

The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel dropped from #4 to #5 in its seventh weekend. The film earned 67,651,500 yen (about US$425,300) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,254,412,700 yen (about US$14.17 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #3 to #6 in its 18th weekend. The film earned 47,706,300 yen (about US$299,900) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 19,041,427,200 yen (about US$119 million). The film has sold approximately 13.06 million tickets.

The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

The Gekijō-ban Idolm@ster SideM F＠ntastic Battle Fes ～Who goes first～ anime film opened on November 20 and ranked outside the top 10, but earned 36,632,580 yen (about US$230,100) in its first three days.

The Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance) film dropped off the top 10 in its second weekend. The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise also dropped off the top 10 in its seventh weekend. Finally, the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga also dropped off the top 10 in its fifth weekend.

title: Live-Action 'Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni' Series Reveals Cast, Theme Song Artists, January 2027 Streaming Debut
content:
The staff for the live-action "short" series of Izumi Miyazono 's Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni (Let's Get Married, Before We Fall in Love) manga announced its cast, theme song artists, and January 2027 streaming debut on Wednesday.

Former Nogizaka46 idol group member Tamami Sakaguchi plays Natsuki Minase, while pop group Genin wa Jibun ni Aru. member Jun Mutō ( When It Rains, It Pours ) plays Tōma Takamura.

Rock band YU's is performing the series' theme song.

The drama will feature "famous scenes" from the manga that can be watched on a smartphone.

The manga centers on a girl named Natsuki, an office worker who is looking for a boyfriend and wants to get married eventually, and the office's elite lawyer who claims he is not interested in love. Something about the lawyer attracts Natsuki closer, and the love battle begins.

Miyazono launched the manga in Petit Comic in October 2022. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on July 9.

Miyazono launched the Fumin Fukyū de Yume to ka Koi to ka (Dreams and Love in Insomnia) manga in Petit Comic in June 2021. The manga ended in August 2022. Shogakukan published the manga's second and final compiled book volume in September 2022.

Miyazono launched the Everyone's Getting Married ( Totsuzen desu ga, Ashita Kekkon shimasu ) manga in Petit Comic in April 2014, and ended it in May 2018. Shogakukan published nine compiled book volumes for the manga. Viz Media released the entire manga in North America. The manga inspired a live-action television series in 2017.

title: Nioh 3 Game Streams First Look Trailer for New DLC
content:
Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja presented a first look trailer for Nioh 3 , the latest entry in the Nioh franchise, to preview the content in the Bloody Insurrection DLC volume 2 on Tuesday. The new DLC launches on December 17.

English Trailer

Japanese Trailer

The first Hell Rising story expansion DLC launched for PS5 and PC via Steam on August 19.

The Nioh Collection, a game collection that includes the Nioh Remastered – The Complete Edition and Nioh 2 Remastered – The Complete Edition games, debuted for the PS5 in February 2021.

Nioh 2 launched on PlayStation 4 worldwide in March 2020.

The first Nioh game shipped for the PS4 in North America, Europe, and Japan in February 2017. Koei Tecmo America released the game on PC with its DLC expansions under the title Nioh: Complete Edition in November 2017.
